stances.claim: Excellence is not just a corporate value but the governing philosophy that produces human flourishing: 'excellence in our chosen work, vocation or career brings us self-confidence and self-assurance; excellence is our source of self-dignity, self-worth and self-fulfillment.' This is why Metrobank Foundation is right to make excellence its singular 'beacon and anchor' rather than distributing its focus across multiple values.
stances.rhetorical_move: excellence-as-self-actualization argument: the philosophical grounding of what might otherwise seem like a corporate platitude

Ty's life is a perfect two-halves biography: first half pioneering the best bank in the Philippines; second half in philanthropy, sharing his fortune with the less privileged by encouraging and rewarding excellence. The two halves are not in tension -- they are expressions of the same governing philosophy.

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered April 4, 2013 at the launching of three Metrobank Foundation coffee table books -- Metrobank Foundation Exemplars (15 best-of-the-best from the Foundation's 34 years, written by 2003 outstanding teacher Dr. Queena L. Chua), MADE of Gold (tribute to the Foundation's arts competitions, written and edited by art critic Cid Reyes), and The Outstanding Filipino Teachers Vol. 2 (sequel to the 2005 National Book Award finalist, written by 2003 awardee Dr. Jaime An Lim; records ten outstanding teachers' bios) -- this address by CJP as Metrobank Foundation Board of Advisers Chairman opens with a tribute to founder Dr. George S.K. Ty: 'trust' is the one word people look for when depositing in banks; he was in his late 20s when he organized and led Metrobank, which Euromoney consistently names Best Bank in the Philippines year after year; 'pioneering the best bank is only half of Dr. Ty's legendary life; the other half is spent in philanthropy, in sharing his fortune with the less privileged, by encouraging and rewarding excellence in all fields of endeavor.' He presents excellence as the Foundation's singular philosophy: 'The Foundation seeks, aspires for, bathes in and promotes excellence all the time, everywhere... Excellence is the Foundation's beacon and anchor... excellence in our chosen work brings us self-confidence and self-assurance; it is our source of self-dignity, self-worth and self-fulfillment.' After 34 years of operation, the Foundation has honored 316 outstanding teachers, 146 soldiers, 98 police officers, 3 journalists, and 376 artists and designers. He closes with a personal tribute to Aniceto 'Chito' Sobrepena -- 'the man who toils behind the success of all the projects of Metrobank Foundation, the personification of excellence himself, the affable and hardworking President' -- ending: 'Mabuhay ka Chito!'
